description: This source file implements a traverser class for transforming embedded uniform structs into named structs within a shader compiler's intermediate representation, facilitating easier management of uniform block declarations.

classes.name: Traverser
classes.description: A class that traverses shader intermediate representation to convert embedded uniform structs into named structs for easier management.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Overrides the base method to process declarations, identifying uniform structs without names and replacing them with named structs.

methods.name: doReplacement
methods.description: Performs the transformation of unnamed uniform structs into named structs and updates the declaration sequence.
